userStatement: 压力场景约 1.7G 没有问题. 不必优化了.
acceptedScope: Existing SVG implementation, 1000 formulas rendered ten times in the measured standalone WebContent process. Three complete runs report rounded 1.7G peaks; earlier partial runs observed 1.8G. This is not a universal hard memory cap.
decision: Accept measured stress cost and stop memory optimization. Keep validated production implementation; discard experimental renderer changes.
